Link the Pairs Rules

Join every pair of equal symbols with a line. The lines may not cross, and together they fill the whole board.

The rules

The board
A square board of cells. Some cells hold a symbol - a number or an animal - and every symbol appears exactly twice.
Lines
Join each pair with a line. A line runs from cell to cell, horizontally and vertically, never diagonally. Lines may not cross, may not share a cell and may not run through another symbol.
The goal
The puzzle is solved when every pair is joined and every cell is used by a line. Every puzzle has exactly one solution.
Drawing
Drag your finger from a symbol, or tap the symbol and then tap the cells one after another. Running into another line cuts that line back. Tap a cell of a line to shorten the line so that it ends there; you can go on drawing from that cell. Tapping a symbol starts its line afresh - tap the symbol where a line begins to clear it.
Numbers or animals
In the menu you choose numbers or animals. Every cell of a line carries a small copy of its symbol, so you can see without colour which line belongs to which pair.
Undo and Hint
Undo takes back as many steps as you like. Hint draws one correct line in full; lines in its way are cut back.
Levels
Easy: 5 x 5. Medium: 7 x 7. Hard: 9 x 9.
